# Install Tailwind CSS with Qwik

Set up Tailwind CSS v4 in a Qwik project with the `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin.

```shell
npm create qwik@latest empty my-project
cd my-project
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
```

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import { qwikVite } from "@builder.io/qwik/optimizer";
import { qwikCity } from "@builder.io/qwik-city/vite";
// (keep the other imports already in the generated file, e.g. UserConfig and tsconfigPaths)

import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'

export default defineConfig(({ command, mode }): UserConfig => {
  return {
    plugins: [
      tailwindcss(),
      qwikCity(),
      qwikVite(),
      tsconfigPaths(),
    ],

    // (keep the rest of the returned config from the generated file)
  }
})
```

```css
/* ./src/global.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
```

```tsx
// index.tsx
import { component$ } from '@builder.io/qwik'

export default component$(() => {
  return (
    <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
      Hello World!
    </h1>
  )
})
```

## Notes

- The `vite.config.ts` snippet is an excerpt of the file generated by `npm create qwik`: only the `tailwindcss()` import and plugin entry are added. The parenthesized comments stand for existing lines that the official guide elides with `// …`; they are not part of the Tailwind setup.
- Start the build with `npm run dev`.
